description: This file generates the list view for emails in the vtiger CRM module, handling sorting, filtering, custom views, pagination, and rendering the email list interface.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Model class representing email records, with methods for initialization and sorting.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations and queries for email list filtering.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the list view interface.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes default sorting fields for the Emails module.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the current view ID for the custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for the custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Fetches details of the current custom view.
